item.title: App icon: port the legacy layered icon (#580)
item.body:
Closes #580
Claim: ext/francoisgn-icon

## Change
- `App/SwiftHFR/Icon-RedFace3D.icon/` (icon.json + 6 PNG) copied byte for byte from legacy `SuperHFRplus/Assets/Icon-RedFace3D.icon/` @ `2440d79` (`diff -r` against `git archive 2440d79`: identical; `icon.json` valid JSON).
- `App/SwiftHFR/Icon-RedFace3DBig.icon/` copied the same way, **unwired** (LOT-123 / #214 alternate icon).
- `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME`: `AppIcon` → `"Icon-RedFace3D"` for the app target, Debug and Release, as legacy (`project.pbxproj:6040, 6125`).
- Empty `AppIcon.appiconset` removed: one icon source only.
- CREDITS.md, GAP-227 row (same, H.1 a), CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 92 ("icône identique au legacy"), LOT-080 note updated.

## ADR 0012
New files sit under the synchronized folder `App/SwiftHFR/`, so no file reference was added to `project.pbxproj`. No `.xcconfig` exists (ADR 0012: settings live in the project file), so the only project-file edit is the two build-setting values below:

```diff
-				ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME = AppIcon;
+				ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME = "Icon-RedFace3D";
```
(twice: Debug, Release of the `SwiftHFR` target).

## CI proof
The synchronized group does pick the `.icon` folders up: the app job's `actool` call receives both, with `--app-icon Icon-RedFace3D`, and the build emplaces `Icon-RedFace3D60x60@2x.png` and `Icon-RedFace3D76x76@2x~ipad.png` in `SwiftHFR.app`.

## Mac check needed
Home Screen in light, dark, clear and tinted; Spotlight; Settings; App Library; iPad.

comments.body:
## Adversarial review (Opus 5.5) at d3a5cba

**Verdict: APPROVE.** I found one low documentation-accuracy finding and nothing that blocks the merge.

### What I checked
- **Assets are byte-identical to legacy.** I compared the sha256 of every file, `git show HEAD:<new>` against `git show 2440d79:<legacy>`, and the 14 of 14 files match.
  - `Icon-RedFace3D.icon` (icon.json plus 6 PNG) matches `SuperHFRplus/Assets/Icon-RedFace3D.icon`, which holds 7 files.
  - `Icon-RedFace3DBig.icon` (icon.json plus 6 PNG) matches `SuperHFRplus/Assets/AlternativeIcons/Icon-RedFace3DBig.icon`. The git blob ids are identical too.
  - Both `icon.json` files parse as JSON.
- **Build settings.**
  - `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME = "Icon-RedFace3D"` is set in both the Debug and the Release configuration of the `SwiftHFR` target (`project.pbxproj:301, 335`). This matches legacy `project.pbxproj:6040, 6125` @ 2440d79.
  - The empty `AppIcon.appiconset` is deleted, and nothing else references `AppIcon`, so there is one icon source.
  - The `project.pbxproj` change is those two values only, with no new object ids. The `.icon` folders are picked up by the synchronized root group `SwiftHFR` (ADR 0012 §26).
  - Build settings stay in the project file, as ADR 0012 line 14 requires.
- **The CI log is consistent.** I read job 128410675425 (App build + tests, success).
  - `actool` gets `Assets.xcassets`, `Icon-RedFace3D.icon` and `Icon-RedFace3DBig.icon` with `--app-icon Icon-RedFace3D`, in Debug-iphonesimulator and in Release-iphoneos.
  - `Icon-RedFace3D60x60@2x.png` and `Icon-RedFace3D76x76@2x~ipad.png` are emplaced in `SwiftHFR.app`.
  - There is no `--alternate-app-icon` and no `--include-all-app-icons` flag, and no actool warning.
- **Scope.** The Big icon is not wired: there is no alternate-icon setting and no `CFBundleAlternateIcons`. That is LOT-123 work.
- **Docs.** CREDITS.md credits the art to FLKone, ezzz and the HFR+ and HFRnow contributors, and names the legacy commit. LOT-080 is updated. GAP-227 is present with the H.1 "a" tally bumped to 45, and CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 92 is present.
- **CI.** The required checks are green. There are no Swift changes, so SwiftLint and the line-length check do not apply.

### Findings
1. **Low: two source statements are inaccurate (LESSONS 3).**
   - **Big icon path.** `CREDITS.md:14` and the PR body give `SuperHFRplus/Assets/` as the source of both icons, but the Big one comes from `SuperHFRplus/Assets/AlternativeIcons/`. Name it so LOT-123 finds the legacy counterpart.
   - **The `.xcconfig` claim.** The PR body says "No `.xcconfig` exists", but `App/Config/Shared.xcconfig` (the ADR 0007 keys) is the targets' `baseConfigurationReference`. The conclusion still holds, since ADR 0012 keeps build settings in the project file, but the stated reason is wrong.

### Numbering (not blocking)
GAP-227 and CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 92 are also used by #576, #577 and #578. The H.1 tally line ("… 221, 227 | 45") must follow whichever number this row gets. The sub-orchestrator renumbers at merge.

### Optional nits
- CHANGELOG-LEGACY registers legacy problems and deliberate changes. "Icône identique au legacy" records neither, so the row could be dropped. The GAP row "same" suffices.
- Because the unwired Big `.icon` sits under the synchronized root, it is already compiled into `Assets.car`. That is harmless and a few KiB, but LOT-123 should know it is already in the bundle.
